key_insight: The paper argues that control theory, optimal transport, probabilistic inference, non-equilibrium thermodynamics, and machine learning are unified by optimizing free-energy-like objectives under constraints.
engineering_relevance: This unifying viewpoint helps engineers transfer methods across reinforcement learning, variational inference, and generative modeling to build more principled learning systems.
method: Identify shared variational and dynamical optimization principles across five fields
Map free-energy-like functionals to constraints in control, transport, and inference
Use selected applications to illustrate the conceptual bridge to learning systems
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a review rather than a new benchmark study, so its support comes from synthesizing theory and applications instead of reporting evaluation metrics.
watch_item: Because this is a cross-disciplinary synthesis, practical use requires careful translation of assumptions and notation between fields.
paper_title: Bridging Control, Inference, Transport, and Thermodynamics: From Theory to Applications in Learning
